basic_info.description: "I never knew this existed!", exclaimed almost everyone who has ever visited this treasure trove of independently owned single family houses. Behind a bank of majestic redwood trees and past a meticulously landscaped path, you'll find this remarkable home serenely sequestered in a park-like setting atop one of the most coveted streets in Dolores Heights. Just imagine living your life like a finely written novel. You begin with a garden prologue that invites alfresco dining in your own botanical oasis. The main-level chapter is devoted to culinary creativity that seamlessly nurtures moments of celebration for groups both large and small enhanced by a kaleidoscope of verdant and iconic views at nearly every turn. Upstairs awaits a story of comfort with three bedrooms on one level including remodeled bathrooms in the primary bedroom and hallway. The final chapter on the ground floor reveals a full-capacity laundry room and a generous interior-access garage with room to park two cars side-by-side, store supplies for any occasion, work from home, or start a weekend hobby whenever you feel the inkling. And like the closing lines of a cherished book, once you discover this home, you'll never want to forget it.
